data.one_liner: Dart implementation of the Language Server Protocol for building LSP servers.
data.what_it_does: Provides a fully spec‑compliant LSP server implementation with generic event registration and request handling. It includes all serializable objects from the LSP v3.17 spec and supports document synchronization and language features.
use_when: Building a language server for a Dart/Flutter editor plugin
Implementing custom LSP features like linting or go‑to‑definition
Creating a standalone LSP server for tooling
avoid_when: Using it as a client‑side library for consuming LSP services
Relying on it for production‑grade editor extensions that require full protocol support yet to be implemented
strengths: Stream‑based API for easy integration with stdio or sockets
Generic listener registration for events and methods
weaknesses: Missing protocol features (workspaces, window, notebook, etc.)
No built‑in UI or editor integration
data.setup_notes: Create a Connection with stdin/stdout or a custom stream, register listeners, and call listen()
